reports.title: Provisioning Report
reports.description: Downloads a CSV covering {manifest}, {range} — name, phone, tier, purchase date, and eSIM status per person.
reports.duration: This can take up to 30 seconds for large manifests.

usage.staleExplanation: Usage can take a little while to reach us, so this may be behind what has actually been used. Budgets are applied on the reading we have.
usage.neverUpdatedExplanation: We will show usage here once the network reports it.

pending.title: {count} lines are being set up
pending.body: Payment is complete. Setting up lines with the network usually takes a few minutes. You can leave this page — the order will keep going.

partialFailure.title: {failed} of {total} lines could not be set up
partialFailure.body: {succeeded} lines are ready and assigned. The rest can be retried.
partialFailure.noCharge: Retrying does not charge the organization again.

empty.peopleBody: Add people to assign lines to them and see usage and spend in one place.
empty.ordersBody: Bulk orders and their per-line progress will appear here.

blocked.title: Some phones cannot use an eSIM
blocked.body: {count} of the people on this import are on a device that does not support an eSIM, or is locked to one network. Those lines are not included in the order.
blocked.footnote: We check this before payment so an organization is not billed for lines nobody can install.

error.title: That did not work
error.body: Something went wrong at our end. Nothing was charged.

gallery.title: Component gallery
gallery.subtitle: Every state pattern in the design system, on one page. Narrow the window or switch language and everything here has to keep working.
gallery.internalOnlyNote: Internal support tools are a separate, visibly distinct area. An organization administrator never sees this styling, and nobody should mistake one for the other.
